elements.name: title
elements.text: Larger platforms: value and adoption cost

elements.name: subtitle
elements.text: More complexity is acceptable when documentation and saved maintenance justify it.

elements.name: source
elements.text: Scope triage, not a comparative benchmark. Existing VM, isolation and private-model requirements remain unchanged.

elements.name: takeaway text
elements.text: First qualify execution, shared inference, one factory bundle, and evidence-preserving restore.

Larger option	Useful documented capability	Adoption gate / cost
Coder	Workspace access, templates and start/stop	Use when access/provisioning is the bottleneck; qualify persistence and paid features
Temporal	Durable workflows, activities and retries	Use for a demonstrated native durability gap; adds service/worker and replay rules
OpenHands SDK	Coding tools, agent server and persistence	Consider one coding CC; avoid a second lab-wide agent runtime
Harbor / Kubernetes	Registry governance or fleet scheduling	Use an existing registry/provider first; add operations only for a concrete gap
MLflow / extra stores	Run comparison UI and shared metadata	Optional, lab-scoped initially; never a replacement for accepted-artifact checks
